nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Central networking module for Servo containing core types for HTTP requests/responses, fetch infrastructure, cookie management, resource threading, TLS security, and network error handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust source file using standard library patterns and Servo's IPC infrastructure.

nodes.name: CookieOperationId
nodes.summary: Identifier type for async cookie operations.

nodes.name: LoadContext
nodes.summary: Enum categorizing resource load context: browsing, image, style, script, font, and other resource types.

nodes.name: CustomResponse
nodes.summary: Constructs a custom HTTP response from headers, status code, and body for testing or synthetic responses.

nodes.name: CustomResponseMediator
nodes.summary: Holds the response channel and load URL for custom response mediation.

nodes.name: ReferrerPolicy
nodes.summary: Enum for referrer policy values with parsing from headers and serialization support.

nodes.name: FetchResponseMsg
nodes.summary: Messages for delivering fetch response events: request body, response, chunks, EOF, and CSP violations.

nodes.name: DebugVec
nodes.summary: Wrapper around Vec<u8> providing hex debug formatting for byte arrays.

nodes.name: FetchTaskTarget
nodes.summary: Trait for fetch response target that processes request body, response, chunks, EOF, and CSP violations.

nodes.name: FilteredMetadata
nodes.summary: Filtered response metadata types: basic, CORS, opaque, or opaque redirect.

nodes.name: FetchMetadata
nodes.summary: Response metadata enum: unfiltered or filtered, with CORS cross-origin checking.

nodes.name: TlsSecurityState
nodes.summary: TLS security state enum: insecure, weak, broken, or secure.

nodes.name: TlsSecurityInfo
nodes.summary: Comprehensive TLS connection security information including protocol, cipher, certificates, and HSTS/HPKP status.

nodes.name: DiscardFetch
nodes.summary: Fetch target implementation that discards all response data (used for preflights and keep-alive).

nodes.name: AsyncRuntime
nodes.summary: Simple async runtime wrapper with shutdown capability for the networking layer.

nodes.name: ResourceThreads
nodes.summary: Resource thread manager providing access to cookie operations, cache management, and core resource IPC.

nodes.name: IncludeSubdomains
nodes.summary: Enum for include-subdomains flag in HSTS/HPKP: included or not included.

nodes.name: MessageData
nodes.summary: WebSocket message data: text or binary payload.

nodes.name: WebSocketDomAction
nodes.summary: WebSocket DOM actions: send message or close connection.

nodes.name: WebSocketNetworkEvent
nodes.summary: WebSocket network events: CSP violations, connection established, message received, close, or fail.

nodes.name: FetchChannels
nodes.summary: Channels for delivering fetch responses: response messages, WebSocket events, or prefetch responses.

nodes.name: CoreResourceMsg
nodes.summary: Core resource IPC message enum covering fetch, cookie, cache, file manager, blob token, and exit operations.

nodes.name: BlobTokenRevocationRequest
nodes.summary: Request to revoke a blob token with blob ID and token reference.

nodes.name: BlobTokenRefreshRequest
nodes.summary: Request to refresh a blob token with blob ID and sender for the new token.

nodes.name: SiteDescriptor
nodes.summary: Site descriptor wrapping a domain name string.

nodes.name: CacheEntryDescriptor
nodes.summary: Cache entry descriptor wrapping a key string.

nodes.name: FetchThread
nodes.summary: Dedicated fetch thread that manages active fetches and routes fetch responses to the appropriate targets.

nodes.name: ResourceCorsData
nodes.summary: CORS preflight data: whether preflight is needed and the origin.

nodes.name: Metadata
nodes.summary: Response metadata including URL, content type, charset, headers, status, timing, and TLS security info.

nodes.name: CookieSource
nodes.summary: Cookie source enum: HTTP or non-HTTP.

nodes.name: CookieChange
nodes.summary: Cookie change notification: changed or deleted.

nodes.name: CookieData
nodes.summary: Cookie data operations: change, get, get all, set, or delete.

nodes.name: CookieAsyncResponse
nodes.summary: Async cookie response container.

nodes.name: NetworkError
nodes.summary: Comprehensive network error enum covering cancellations, TLS, CORS, redirects, CSP, MIME, and HTTP errors.

nodes.name: start_fetch_thread
nodes.summary: start_fetch_thread function handling no parameters.

nodes.name: exit_fetch_thread
nodes.summary: exit_fetch_thread function handling no parameters.

nodes.name: fetch_async
nodes.summary: Initiates an asynchronous fetch by sending a start message to the fetch thread.

nodes.name: cancel_async_fetch
nodes.summary: cancel_async_fetch function handling request_ids, core_resource_thread.

nodes.name: trim_http_whitespace
nodes.summary: Trims leading and trailing HTTP whitespace bytes from a byte slice.

nodes.name: get_current_locale
nodes.summary: Gets the current system locale string with caching and override support.

nodes.name: set_default_accept_language
nodes.summary: Sets the Accept-Language header from the system locale if not already set.

nodes.name: mime_classifier.rs
nodes.summary: Implements MIME type sniffing per the Fetch specification, with byte pattern matchers for images, audio/video, scripts, fonts, archives, and text content types.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust source file using standard library patterns and Servo's IPC infrastructure.

nodes.name: MimeClassifier
nodes.summary: MIME type classifier implementing the Fetch specification sniffing algorithm with sub-classifiers for each media type.

nodes.name: MediaType
nodes.summary: Media type categories: XML, HTML, audio/video, image, JavaScript, JSON, font, text, CSS.

nodes.name: ApacheBugFlag
nodes.summary: Flag for the Apache bug workaround in MIME sniffing: on or off.

nodes.name: NoSniffFlag
nodes.summary: Flag for the X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header: on or off.

nodes.name: MIMEChecker
nodes.summary: Trait for MIME type checkers with classify and validate methods.

nodes.name: ByteMatcher
nodes.summary: Byte pattern matcher for identifying file types by examining leading bytes with optional masks.

nodes.name: TagTerminatedByteMatcher
nodes.summary: Byte matcher that finds patterns terminated by HTML tags.

nodes.name: Mp4Matcher
nodes.summary: MP4 file type matcher using ISO base media file format box structure.

nodes.name: BinaryOrPlaintextClassifier
nodes.summary: Classifier that determines if content is binary or plaintext by analyzing byte patterns.

nodes.name: GroupedClassifier
nodes.summary: Classifier that groups multiple byte matchers and tries each in sequence.

nodes.name: policy_container.rs
nodes.summary: Defines policy container types for content security policy (CSP), referrer policy, and embedder policy used in request processing.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust source file using standard library patterns and Servo's IPC infrastructure.

nodes.name: RequestPolicyContainer
nodes.summary: Enum for request policy: client-default or explicit policy container.

nodes.name: PolicyContainer
nodes.summary: Container for content security policy, embedder policy, and referrer policy for a request.

nodes.name: EmbedderPolicy
nodes.summary: Embedder policy value wrapper.

nodes.name: EmbedderPolicyValue
nodes.summary: Embedder policy values: unsafe-none or require-corp.

nodes.name: pub_domains.rs
nodes.summary: Implements public suffix list matching for domain registration boundaries, same-site determination, and cookie scoping rules.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust source file using standard library patterns and Servo's IPC infrastructure.

nodes.name: PubDomainRules
nodes.summary: PubDomainRules type with 3 variants/properties.

nodes.name: is_same_site
nodes.summary: Determines if two origins are same-site using public suffix matching.

nodes.name: registered_domain_name
nodes.summary: Extracts the registered domain name from a URL.
